newsitem.title: USA: Comstock sees further production increases.
newsitem.headline: Comstock sees further production increases.

text.p: Comstock Resources Inc expects to achieve further hydrocarbon production increases as a result of "continued success" in its ongoing $33 million drilling program for 1997, M. Jay Allison, president and chief executive, said Monday.

Comstock, an independent energy company, produced 14.7 billion cubic feet equivalent (bcfe) of natural gas in the first six months of 1997, 47 percent more than the 10 bcfe produced for the first half of 1996, the company said.
For the three months ended June 30, 1997, it produced 7.4 bcfe of natural gas as compared to 6.3 bcfe in the second quarter of 1996, an increase of 18 percent, it said.
"The 47 percent increase in production in 1997 is a result of our acquisitions and new production added by our development program," Allison said.
